description:
Who opted out of messages from this number, oldest first. By default it
lists active opt-outs only.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

active.description: `true` for active only, `false` for lifted only, `all` for both.

customer.description: Find one customer by any spelling of their number.

number_id.description:
Id of a WhatsApp number in your workspace, from
[listWhatsappNumbers](/docs/api-reference/whatsapp/listWhatsappNumbers).
A number in another workspace answers `404`.
